correctness.rationale: Solve x(2−x−y)=u, with 0<u<1, to get y=2−x−u/x on x∈[1−sqrt(1−u),1]. The target predator coordinate h_u(x)=(2−x−u/x)(A+γx) has h″=−2γ−2Au/x³<0; derivatives at left/right boundary are positive/negative, proving a unique strict interior fold maximum, hence exactly two interior antecedents iff (1−u)(A+γ)<v<h_u(x*). Parametrize fold by t=x, y_c=2(1−t)(A+γt)/A, u_c=t²(1−2γ/A+2γt/A), t∈[max(0,1−A/(2γ)),1]. Integrate (v_c−v0)du_c/dt to obtain branches (5A²−5Aγ+2γ²)/(30A) for γ≤A/2 and A²(A²−10Aγ+40γ²)/(480γ³) for γ≥A/2. Their analytic expression difference is (2γ−A)^5/(480Aγ³); first four jets match, fifth difference 64/A⁴. The double-region ratio at transition is 2/17; explicitly checked both algebraic predecessors at r=1/2,gamma=1/3. I independently differentiated and integrated the polynomial fold integrand with SymPy and numerical quadrature for parameters on both sides; the continuum concavity proof, not finite samples, establishes all fibers.
